summary: Datasheet-verified cross-reference alternatives for LM1117IMPX-3.3/NOPB (Texas Instruments, SOT-223-3, fixed-ldo): evaluated 29 same-category OPNs, surfacing 2 Level 1 Candidate Drop-In, 2 Level 2 Tuning Required, and 4 Level 3 Layout Change options. Verify pinout, thermal margin, and official manufacturer datasheets before production.

candidates.key_tradeoff: Verify θJA (90 °C/W) and latest Advanced Monolithic Systems datasheet revision
Verify θJA (160 °C/W) and latest onsemi datasheet revision

candidates.key_advantage: Lower Iq (65 µA vs 5000 µA); Lower dropout (800 mV vs 1200 mV)
candidates.key_tradeoff: Verify θJA (95.4 °C/W) and latest Texas Instruments datasheet revision

candidates.key_advantage: Ceramic MLCC stable (no tantalum ESR floor)
candidates.key_tradeoff: Verify θJA (125 °C/W) and latest Diodes Incorporated datasheet revision

candidates.compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)
candidates.key_advantage: Lower Iq (60 µA vs 5000 µA); Higher Iout (1000 mA vs 800 mA)
candidates.key_tradeoff: Pinout or exposed-pad mismatch requires PCB rerouting; Lower Vin,max (6 V vs 15 V)

candidates.compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)
candidates.key_advantage: Lower Iq (2000 µA vs 5000 µA); Higher Vin,max (26 V vs 15 V)
candidates.key_tradeoff: Pinout or exposed-pad mismatch requires PCB rerouting; Lower Iout (400 mA vs 800 mA)

candidates.compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)
candidates.key_advantage: Lower Iq (20 µA vs 5000 µA); Higher Vin,max (24 V vs 15 V)
candidates.key_tradeoff: Package change (SOT-223-3 → SOT-23-5) requires PCB layout mod; Lower Iout (150 mA vs 800 mA)

candidates.compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)
candidates.key_advantage: Lower Iq (2000 µA vs 5000 µA); Higher Vin,max (30 V vs 15 V)
candidates.key_tradeoff: Package change (SOT-223-3 → SOT-23-3) requires PCB layout mod; Lower Iout (100 mA vs 800 mA)

selection_checklist: Verify exact pin numbering on SOT-223-3 (1=GND, 2=VOUT, 3=VIN) and exposed pad net (VOUT).
Confirm output capacitor ESR stability (ESR window 0.3–22 Ω (p.15)) and DC-bias derated capacitance >= 10 µF.
Check worst-case junction temperature Tj = Ta + (Vin,max - 3.3 V) × Iout × θJA stays >= 15 °C below Tj,max (125 °C).
Validate input transient headroom against Vin,max (15 V rec / 20 V abs) and Pin 4 (NC vs BYPASS) PCB net connectivity.
